question: May runtime locale selection change gateway JSON error.message and reason fields, or should this PR keep those protocol-facing fields stable and localize only display/client surfaces?
rationale: The PR localizes strings returned inside gateway JSON shapes that also carry stable code/type fields; automation can verify the code, but cannot safely decide whether existing clients may treat those message/reason strings as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Keep Protocol Text Stable
options.body: Preserve stable gateway JSON message/reason text and localize only channel/client display copy unless a typed display contract exists.

options.title: Approve Localized Gateway Messages
options.body: Treat code/type fields as the supported contract and allow message/reason to follow locale once the authMode repair and tests are in place.

options.title: Narrow Runtime I18n
options.body: Limit this PR to channel/TUI runtime copy and leave gateway JSON localization to a separate API-contract discussion.

recommendation.title: Keep Protocol Text Stable
recommendation.body: Preserve stable gateway JSON message/reason text and localize only channel/client display copy unless a typed display contract exists.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from recent gateway, control-ui, auto-reply, and wizard i18n history.
